authority.adapter: Native #81 Raw Invoker SharePoint envelope. Resolve currentuser.Id to exactly one Participants.ParticipantaccountId.
authority.require: Resolved profile equals number and Personal recipient, no TargetGroup, different sender; current recipient account binding rechecked.

shared.gates: success=true/resultcode=OK plus resultjson code/versions/authorizesAction=false; PAIR result.eligible; GROUP result.purposeValid AND capacityValid
shared.initialGroupMeaning: GROUP evaluates both proposed members with Closed/setupComplete=false/focusSharersAvailable=false. Its join-only compatible=false is expected and does not authorize initial creation.
shared.data: Two current REST profiles, complete active catalogue sets, Any sentinel resolved by ISOcode=any even if inactive, explicit null if absent; optional TimezoneId remains null.
shared.freshness: PAIR/GROUP before decision and before publication; subsequent exact profile ETag comparisons. Parent retains request CAS and group guard.
shared.unchanged: No shared child, schema baseline, normalization/rules source or imported flow changed.

storage.receiptSchemaOwner: #81 finalized generation contract; not tenant verified
storage.writeOwner: OperationKey + ':' + AttemptToken; plain string; other writers check empty/exact match, never parse

recovery.safeBoundary: Member-create definite HTTP400/401/403/404/409/412/422 rejection plus successful complete unique-key absence readback. Earlier effects have passed exact readbacks.
recovery.retry: Seal UUID/Retryable then exact-token release. Same immutable intent can CAS-claim, finalize failed sealed release, revalidate/reuse source group and existing episodes. Left/mismatched episodes fail.
recovery.unknown: Timeout/429/5xx without exact stable readback: Uncertain, retain token, no lease/TTL takeover. Exceptional assistance verifies settled runs/data.
recovery.completed: Save/verify receipt before release. Failed release returns false; completed replay finalizes matching old-token release only and returns historical result.

tenantGates: Parent receipt setup/readback and request-field audit
Existing child/Invoker reference in permitted environment
Legacy child-reference resolution or companion parent-only Solution import
Actual Power Apps trusted caller and intended read/write rights under existing entitlements
issueMutation: None; owner requested commit only. #81 change-ledger handoff in docs/ISSUE_11_RESPOND_REQUEST.md.

requestProducerContract.title: Personal request
requestProducerContract.typed: Positive numeric party IDs; Personal, TargetGroupId=null, status/completion/winner/key consistency.

requestProducerContract.testEvidence: Correct #10 saved-row seed and preservation/history tests. No producer flow imported or tenant roundtrip claimed.

implementationRefinement.sequentialMembers: One native Foreach over sender/recipient IDs, concurrency1. Failed iteration leaves MembersContinue=false; later iteration performs no I/O. VerifiedMembers must equal2 before commit.
implementationRefinement.reconciledFailures: Foreach and business branch may aggregate Failed after an exact saved-row readback. Post-container gates accept only verified iteration count/result markers, never container status alone.
implementationRefinement.commonStages: One effect marker, Pending decision and receipt completion; grouped identical read-only predicates; native typed assertion guard.
implementationRefinement.guard: Stage code followed by ParseJson object passed:boolean enum[true]. No divide-by-zero branch. Catch restores the original operation code.
